name: daobrew-video
description: Apply DaoBrew's video editing house style to HyperFrames compositions, including script-sourced captions, readable overlays, soft PiP panels, and the DaoBrew outro.

name: hyperframes
description: Use as the mandatory entry point for creating, editing, inspecting, validating, previewing, or rendering any HyperFrames video or motion composition.

name: hyperframes-core
description: Use for the HyperFrames composition contract, timing attributes, clips, tracks, sub-compositions, framework-owned media, and deterministic rendering rules.

name: hyperframes-cli
description: Use for the HyperFrames CLI development loop, validation, diagnostics, previews, renders, publishing, and supported cloud rendering workflows.

name: general-video
description: Use to author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, including longer multi-scene pieces, reels, montages, and footage remixes.

name: media-use
description: Use Agent Media OS to resolve, generate, transform, freeze, ledger, and reuse BGM, SFX, images, icons, logos, voices, captions, color grades, and other HyperFrames media.

name: hyperframes-audio
description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs mixing, fades, ducking, effects, automation envelopes, or submix buses.
